en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a lakeshore with tall grasses and several large trees in the foreground. Across the water in the background stands a grand Renaissance-style lakeside castle with four prominent round corner towers topped by domes and a central building mass. The image has wide margins typical of an old photographic postcard; no printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the front.
